act-find-source-annual-independent.name: Find an outside source to check people per household each year (SDWS 25) [act-find-source-annual-independent]
act-find-source-annual-independent.title: Find an outside source to check people per household each year (SDWS 25)

evidence.text:
annual independent cross-check of people per premises (SDWS 25), 7 Oct 2026.

Source: INSTAT RGPH-3, census of June 2018 — the most recent official household size by region.
• Anosy 4.3 (Tome 1, Tableau 26, p.41); Taolagnaro district 4.3 (Tome 2, Tableau 14, p.160); urban commune of Fort Dauphin 4.0 (Tome 2, Tableau 16, p.213).
• Analanjirofo 3.6 (Tome 1, Tableau 26, p.41); Maroantsetra district 3.6 (Tome 2, Tableau 14, p.159); urban commune of Maroantsetra 3.3 (Tome 2, Tableau 16, p.195).

Checked first, in order: INSTAT TBSE Dec 2025 — the Analanjirofo edition (Tableau 4, PDF p.20) only reprints the 2018 census sizes (it prints 3,5 for the region; the census counts themselves round to 3.6); no Anosy edition exists. EDS-V 2021 (household composition table) gives national 4.3, urban 4.0, rural 4.4 only.

Comparison with the project survey, Nov 2025 (people per premises):
• Fort-Dauphin 4.47: +0.17 (+4%) above Anosy and Taolagnaro; +0.47 (+12%) above Fort Dauphin town.
• Maroantsetra 3.66: +0.06 (+2%) above Analanjirofo and the district; +0.36 (+11%) above Maroantsetra town.
Census figures not scaled for growth (growth changes the number of households, not their size). The census counts ordinary households; the survey counts premises, which can hold more than one household.

Files: Central Data Hub - Water Documents/Evidence/SDWS25 household size/ (RGPH-3 Tome 1 and Tome 2, RGPH-3 household characteristics report, TBSE Analanjirofo Dec 2025, EDS-V 2021 FR376). On the report: SDWS 25 section, #sdws25-crosscheck.
evidence.author: Adriaan Mol

evidence.text:
Cathy's emails of 7 Oct 2026 ("Re: Fluoride photometer used for the SDWS 3 tests: model, range and five 1.5 mg/L readings", 09:17 and 13:29 UTC) answer all three points.
(1) Photometer: Lumiso Expert (technical sheet attached to her 09:17 email); test AP179/PM179 Fluoride, 1 and 2 tablets; range 0–1.5 mg/L. Reagent lots: AP179L IF035/IF128 (best before 06/2028) and AP179 HI034/HI016 (best before 09/2029); a third 2025 box is no longer available.
(2) The five 1.5 mg/L readings (800634100, 797195318, 794012210, 797195301, 797885233) were above the measuring range, not real readings. The samples were diluted and retested; Cathy is looking for the archived diluted results.
(3) 800634100 and 794012210 will go in the Institut Pasteur Part B round as planned.
Follow-up for the diluted results is a separate task.
evidence.author: Adriaan Mol

act-mwater-backup-restore-check.name: Check what the mWater form restore brought back or lost [act-mwater-backup-restore-check]
act-mwater-backup-restore-check.title: Check what the mWater form restore brought back or lost

evidence.text:
Form 0ac68d8274d24f54af0c28b29119b77d, "Piped Water || Water Quality Testing_ SDWS 3__ Result", carries the "Fer > 0.2 mg/l" calculation (36d19995…). mWater restored this form on 23 Sep (John Feighery, "Re: Piped Water survey"). It was repaired to rev 116 the same day. It is now at rev 120 (build snapshot of 5 Oct; the MCP does not report the revision). No email gives the backup date or the revision it was restored to.

The 26 and 27 Sep "replies from mWater support" are mWater's daily unread reminders. They quote Lanja's own message: "it was the calculation Fer > 0.2 mg/l who was the problem. I tried the backup and it works fine now". That means MadAvance's organisational backup runs again. It does not mean a form was restored from a backup.

Nothing was lost. Checked read-only on 6 Oct against our rev 110 copy (16 Sep) and the snapshots at rev 116, 119 and 120. All 22 questions, their choices, the Temperature and pH validations, the French text on 1.2.1–1.2.3 and all 17 calculations are present.

- "Fer > 0.2 mg/l" had no condition at rev 109 and 110 (when: null). It now reads "If Iron > 0.2 Then 1 Else 0", as its label says.
- The Malagasy locale on Entretien préventif (de26d89a, rev 502 since 21 Sep, locales en and fr) was never added, so it was not lost. That is still act-mwater-mg-locale.
- The SDWS 3 operating-status question (OPSTATUS) was added on 29 Sep, after the restore, on the sampling form 43c96af4. It is present live.
- None of the 13 snapshot forms changed revision between 26 and 28 Sep.

Full write-up: Central Data Hub - Water Documents/Evidence/mWater/form-restore-check-2026-10-06.md
evidence.author: Adriaan Mol
